I'll start by looking at the project layout and the build contract.

Several defects are visible already. I'm rewriting the build files now.

I'll write the files one at a time.

The write to the top-level `Makefile.am` was denied. I'll check why.

The failure looks transient, so I'll retry the write.

Next I'll run the default build and check it.

The default build passes. I'll add an `m4/` placeholder, since aclocal warns about the missing directory, then check the installed tree, rpath and exports.

The default build works. Now the variants.

One test fails under the changed `VERSION`. I'll check whether that comes from the test case.

Only the `version` case fails, and it hardcodes 1.4.0, so that's expected. Next I'll run `make distcheck`, rebuild from the tarball, and build consumers with pkg-config.

`_DATA` files aren't distributed automatically, so I'll add `units.tsv` to `EXTRA_DIST`.

The `data/Makefile.am` write hit an `EBUSY` error, so I'll retry it.

`make distcheck` passes and the unpacked tarball rebuilds. Last, the consumer builds with pkg-config, shared and static.

The build now meets `docs/BUILDING.md`. I checked it in scratch copies of `/app`, with the full sequence on the default build and the install-to-prefix and consumer checks on the variants.

- **Default build:** `autoreconf -fi`, a VPATH build, `make`, `make check`, install and uninstall all work. `make check` passes both `unit` and `cli.test`.
- **Distribution:** `make distcheck` passes. The tarball unpacks and rebuilds after `autoreconf -fi`, and `make check` passes there.
- **Variants:**
  - `--disable-shared`, `--disable-tool` and `--libdir=…/lib64` with another `--datarootdir` all build, check, install and uninstall cleanly. After uninstall nothing is left under `DESTDIR`.
  - A changed `VERSION` and interface version gives `libisodur.so.3.4.0` and `isodur --version` reports the new number.
- **Installed trees:** copied to their prefix and run with `env -i`, `isodur` and `durfmt` work. The lib64 build finds its `units.tsv` in the other `datarootdir`. The shared library exports only `isodur_*` symbols.
- **Consumers:** shared and static consumers built with `pkg-config`, and static ones with `pkg-config --static --libs`. A shared consumer in a non-standard prefix needs `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` to run, as `docs/consuming.md` says.

One thing to know: with another `VERSION`, `make check` fails only on `tests/cases/version`, because that case hardcodes `1.4.0`. I can't change the tests.

The main fixes:

- **Version:** `AC_INIT` now reads `VERSION`, and the interface version flows from the three `m4_define` lines into `-version-info`.
- **Library:** the symbol export regex and the math library link are added.
- **Data directory:** it is compiled in from `$(pkgdatadir)`, not `config.h`.
- **Install paths:** headers install to `include/isodur`, and `isodur.pc` installs into `$(libdir)/pkgconfig` with every path taken from configure.
- **`durfmt`:** the link honours `DESTDIR` and is removed on uninstall.
- **Tests and dist:** `BUILD_TOOL` is always defined, and `cli.test` runs only when the tool is built. The tarball now includes `units.tsv`, the test cases and `VERSION`.
- **`m4/isodur.m4`:** a comment-only file I added so the `m4/` directory exists, which stops an aclocal warning.

`/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `success`.

command_result.command: cd /app && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | sort | head -200 && cat docs/BUILDING.md

cd /app && for f in configure.ac Makefile.am data/Makefile.am lib/Makefile.am src/Makefile.am tests/Makefile.am isodur.pc.in include/isodur/version.h.in VERSION CHANGELOG.md docs/consuming.md docs/isodur.md tests/cli.test; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls -a; git status 2>&1 | head -3
cd /app && grep -n 'ISODUR_DATADIR\|config.h\|VERSION\|include\|isodur__\|lround\|data' lib/*.c lib/internal.h src/main.c tests/unit.c | head -80; cat include/isodur/isodur.h | head -80

rm -rf /tmp/w && cp -r /app /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w && autoreconf -fi 2>&1 | tail -20; mkdir b && cd b && ../configure --prefix=/tmp/inst >/dev/null && make 2>&1 | grep -i 'warn\|error' ; make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^(# |PASS|FAIL|ERROR)'; make install DESTDIR=/tmp/dd >/dev/null 2>&1; find /tmp/dd | sort; grep -n 'version-info\|^ISODUR_LT' Makefile lib/Makefile | head

bash /tmp/t.sh def '' 2>&1; P=/tmp/pfx_def; env -i $P/bin/isodur --version; env -i $P/bin/durfmt --style long PT1H5M; env -i $P/bin/isodur sum < /dev/null; readelf -d $P/bin/isodur | grep -i 'path\|NEEDED'; nm -D --defined-only $P/lib/libisodur.so | grep -v ' isodur_'; readelf -d $P/lib/libisodur.so | grep -i 'soname\|NEEDED'; cat $P/lib/pkgconfig/isodur.pc

cd /tmp; bash t.sh l64 '--libdir=/tmp/pfx_l64/lib64 --datarootdir=/tmp/pfx_l64/dr' 2>&1; P=/tmp/pfx_l64; env -i $P/bin/durfmt --style long PT1H5M; env -i $P/bin/isodur parse 1h30m; cat $P/lib64/pkgconfig/isodur.pc; echo =====static; bash t.sh st '--disable-shared' 2>&1; env -i /tmp/pfx_st/bin/durfmt PT90M; echo ====notool; bash t.sh nt '--disable-tool' 2>&1; echo ===ver; bash t.sh ver '' 2.5.1 2>&1; env -i /tmp/pfx_ver/bin/isodur --version; ls /tmp/pfx_ver/lib
cd /app/tests/cases && cat version.args version.out; cd /tmp/t_ver/b && grep -h 'FAIL' -A4 tests/cli.test.log | head -20

cd /tmp/t_def/b && make distcheck 2>&1 | tail -8; ls *.tar.gz; rm -rf /tmp/u && mkdir /tmp/u && cd /tmp/u && tar xf /tmp/t_def/b/isodur-1.4.0.tar.gz && cd isodur-1.4.0 && autoreconf -fi >/dev/null 2>&1 && mkdir b && cd b && ../configure >/dev/null && make >/dev/null 2>&1 && make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (PASS|FAIL)'; tar tzf /tmp/t_def/b/isodur-1.4.0.tar.gz | grep -E 'm4/isodur|cases/sum|internal|VERSION|units'
tar tzf /tmp/t_def/b/isodur-1.4.0.tar.gz | grep -E 'data|isodur-1.4.0/[^/]*$'; cat /app/data/Makefile.am; grep -n DIST_COMMON /tmp/t_def/data/Makefile.in | head -3
